name: engineering-strategy
description: Engineering strategy. Skills: engineering-strategy (full five steps; writes docs/engineering-strategy.md or docs/<slug>-engineering-strategy.md in reader order: policy, operations, refine, diagnose, explore; Draft until human sign-off), strategy-explore (alternatives, state of the art, implicit rules already in the repo), strategy-diagnosis (theory of the challenge; dissenting views; data when it exists), strategy-refine (modes test / map / model / both / skip), strategy-operations (inspect, exception, cadence), strategy-evaluate (existing strategy: iterate speed, cost of the next test, fit to diagnosis). Invoke strategy-explore when priors are thin; strategy-diagnosis when the challenge is unclear; strategy-refine before org-wide pressure; strategy-operations when policies need inspection; strategy-evaluate on a living file; engineering-strategy for the living document.
